object:tinning kit.visualDescription: Three blue-gray cylindrical tins with pale lids overlap as a compact kit.
object:tinning kit.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the tinning kit as an iron chargeable tool for preserving corpses in tins.
object:tinning kit.modelBrief: Build a small cluster of gray metal canisters with bright rims, keeping the kit portable.

object:tin opener.visualDescription: A brown wooden handle supports a short gray metal opener with a bent cutting tip.
object:tin opener.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the tin opener as an iron tool that opens food tins quickly.
object:tin opener.modelBrief: Model a simple hand tool with warm wood grip and hooked steel cutting head.

object:can of grease.visualDescription: A small upright grease can has an olive lid, tan label, dark gray sides, and pale vertical mark.
object:can of grease.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the can of grease as a chargeable tool used to grease equipment.
object:can of grease.modelBrief: Build a squat metal cylinder with brown cap and plain cream label; keep grease inside the container.

object:figurine.visualDescription: A tiny rust-orange humanoid figurine stands on a flat brown pedestal with arms spread.
object:figurine.wikiDescription: The wiki describes figurines as magic miniature statues of monsters that can become living monsters.
object:figurine.modelBrief: Make this crop's simple small humanoid statuette on a base; allow the depicted monster form to vary elsewhere.

object:magic marker.visualDescription: A slim diagonal marker shows bands of cyan, yellow, orange, and red, ending in a dark nib.
object:magic marker.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the magic marker as a charged tool for writing magical scrolls and spellbooks.
object:magic marker.modelBrief: Build a narrow pen with brightly segmented barrel and dark writing tip, preserving its diagonal visual read.

object:land mine.visualDescription: A low brass-brown land mine is a flattened circular disc with raised central pressure plate.
object:land mine.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a land mine as a portable explosive trap that can be set on the ground.
object:land mine.modelBrief: Make a squat round metal mine with dark sides and a pale central trigger, without an active explosion.

object:beartrap.visualDescription: A gray steel beartrap has open serrated jaws and a vertical spring or lever on one side.
object:beartrap.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the beartrap as an iron tool commonly seen as a primed ground trap.
object:beartrap.modelBrief: Model an open hinged jaw trap with heavy teeth, base plate, and side mechanism.

object:whistle / tin whistle.visualDescription: A small pale silver whistle lies horizontally with a dark mouthpiece and open end.
object:whistle / tin whistle.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the tin whistle as a non-magical metal instrument that makes a loud sound.
object:whistle / tin whistle.modelBrief: Make a short smooth gray whistle with mouth slot and hollow end, using the shared whistle shape.

object:whistle / magic whistle.visualDescription: The same short silver whistle has a pale body and dark mouth opening.
object:whistle / magic whistle.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the magic whistle as a metal instrument that summons a pet to the user's location.
object:whistle / magic whistle.modelBrief: Reuse the plain gray whistle form; keep the teleporting or summoning effect separate.

object:flute / wooden flute.visualDescription: A long narrow wooden flute lies diagonally, brown with dark finger-hole marks.
object:flute / wooden flute.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the wooden flute as a non-magical tonal instrument made of wood.
object:flute / wooden flute.modelBrief: Model a slim reddish wooden tube with open tip and evenly spaced finger holes.

object:flute / magic flute.visualDescription: The tile repeats the long brown flute with a tapered tip and small dark finger holes.
object:flute / magic flute.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the magic flute as a magical wooden instrument that can put nearby monsters to sleep.
object:flute / magic flute.modelBrief: Reuse the visible wooden flute design; magical sleep belongs to the instrument's effect.

object:horn / tooled horn.visualDescription: A curved cream horn has a wide dark mouth, brown tip, and small dotted tooling marks along the side.
object:horn / tooled horn.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the tooled horn as a non-magical bone instrument appearing simply as a horn.
object:horn / tooled horn.modelBrief: Make a short curved ivory-bone horn with carved dots and dark hollow bell.
